reason: B is the stronger proposal because it tests a composition-specific Cr–Ta oxide mechanism over a substantially longer exposure and defines broader temperature, time, and loading boundaries, whereas A largely restates the generic alumina-former concept and only repeats the prior 5 h condition. Its main risk is that high Ti and reactive Hf/Zr may prevent a continuous CrTaO4 scale and Cr-induced Laves phases may impair ductility, but these are directly testable in the proposed experiment.
